change_summary: Give long-running Questions one durable cross-host operation with cursor-bounded milestones, verified cancellation, explicit successor lineage, and terminal effect readback across MCP, CLI, Skill, and Help.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill adds one durable Question lifecycle, cursor-based milestone reads, truthful cancellation, successor Questions, and terminal completion boundaries without exposing hidden reasoning.

server_contract.note: The machine-readable contract, MCP tools, public REST API, and canonical Run journal expose one resumable operation with safe progress deltas, cancellation, and terminal readback.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together because exported source and immutable release assets change as one package family.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI advance together to 0.1.0-beta.38; background ask, operation wait with cursor continuity, explicit cancel, and typed local-deadline receipts share the server lifecycle.

help_center.note: English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese host guides explain progress cursors, meaningful updates, explicit cancellation, successor Questions, and terminal truth.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the synchronized release/revision and reminds hosts to keep one operation, report only meaningful milestones, and verify cancellation or completion.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records portable operation state, snapshot-plus-delta observation, control truth, native MCP Tasks compatibility, and acceptance boundaries.

external_marketplaces.note: External marketplace review remains account-owned and is not implied by first-party publication.

public_release_assets.note: The unchanged canonical exporter regenerates both public packages from the revised Skill, API reference, and synchronized Plugin manifests.

release_evidence.note: Contract, API, MCP, CLI, package and localized Help tests cover start, cursor continuation, legacy wait compatibility, cancellation truth, terminal readback, and version synchronization.
